definitions.gloss: caller ID; number display; number notification
definitions.explanation: A telephone feature that displays the caller's phone number on the recipient's screen before the call is answered.

examples.japanese: {番号通知|ばんごうつうち}がオフになっている。
{番号通知|ばんごうつうち}なしの{電話|でんわ}には{出|で}ないことにしている。
examples.english: I've decided not to answer calls without caller ID.

examples.japanese: {迷惑|めいわく}{電話|でんわ}が{多|おお}いので、{番号通知|ばんごうつうち}を{確認|かくにん}してから{出|で}るようにしている。
examples.english: Since I get a lot of spam calls, I check the caller ID before answering.

notes:
Composed of {番号|ばんごう} (number) and {通知|つうち} (notification). In Japan, NTT's caller ID service is called ナンバーディスプレイ, but {番号通知|ばんごうつうち} is the more general, carrier-neutral term used for the concept itself.

Calls made without displaying the number are described as {非通知|ひつうち} (withheld number), and many Japanese people automatically reject {非通知|ひつうち} calls due to the prevalence of phone scams.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番号通知|ばんごうつうち}サービス: caller ID service
- {番号通知|ばんごうつうち}を{設定|せってい}する: to set up caller ID
- {番号通知|ばんごうつうち}{拒否|きょひ}: blocking calls without caller ID

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ナンバーディスプレイ: Number Display — NTT's branded caller ID service
- {非通知|ひつうち}: withheld number; anonymous call
- {着信|ちゃくしん}{履歴|りれき}: call history; call log
